translations.web: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
translations.bsb: Should I not punish them for these things?” declares the LORD. “Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
translations.kjv: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation
